messages.content: 你能找到從我在舊金山的家到我在帕羅奧圖辦公室的最快路線，然後從辦公室到我朋友在聖荷西的家，最後從我朋友的家回到我的家，同時避開收費公路嗎？

function.name: map_routing_fastest_route
function.description: Finds the fastest route from one location to another, with an option to avoid toll roads. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

avoid_tolls.description: Option to avoid toll roads during the journey. default is False

We need to output the result as JSON. The function returns "any" but presumably it will return some structure like distance, duration, route steps etc. We'll just pass through whatever the function returns.

That suggests each function call is separate. So we need to make three separate calls. But we can't do multiple calls in one assistant turn? The guidelines don't forbid multiple calls; they just specify how to format each call. So we can do three calls sequentially. But we need to respond with the function calls. The system might handle them sequentially. So we should produce three lines, each calling the function with appropriate arguments.

